binance-cex.description: Binance is a cryptocurrency exchange which is the largest exchange in the world in terms of daily trading volume of cryptocurrencies

stellar-defi-hub.description: Stellar DeFi Hub is a platform that allows users to deposit Stellar-based assets into secure vaults and accrue rewards

aquarius-stellar.description: Aquarius is a novel AMM protocol and a liquidity management layer to Stellar. It offers stable and volatile pools with multihop swaps on top, and a community governance tool to distribute rewards between pool liquidity providers based on voting and bribing.

gami-labs.description: Gami provides on-chain asset management infrastructure with active curation & dynamic risk management.

upshift.description: Upshift opens access to transparent yields backed by secure risk controls. Supply, stake and access cross-chain yields.

poloniex.description: Poloniex is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange platform where users can deposit, trade, and withdraw a wide range of digital assets with order books, spot trading, derivatives markets, and custodial wallet services provided by the platform operator.

defindex.description: Unlock stablecoin yield in your wallet or DeFi app

stellar-dex.description: The Stellar network acts as a decentralized distributed exchange that allows users to trade and convert assets with the network's Offer operations

templar-protocol.description: Templar is the first Cypher Lending protocol that enables borrowing stablecoins against Bitcoin, or any asset on any chain, without trusting centralized intermediaries. No wrapping, no bridging, no KYC necessary

bitget.description: Bitget is the leading crypto exchange platform for crypto derivatives trading.

stellar-amm.description: Stellar AMM provides a simple way to provide liquidity and exchange assets

gate.description: Established in 2013, Gate is a cryptocurrency exchange serving over 63 million+ global users. The platform supports spot trading, futures trading, margin trading, and wealth management products for more than 5,500+ digital assets and 12,800+ stock assets, using zero-knowledge technology to ensure transparency and verifiability of user assets. Various Gate entities have obtained or completed regulatory registrations, licences, authorizations, or approvals across various jurisdictions

indodax.description: Indodax is a centralized cryptocurrency exchange established in 2014 and is registered in Indonesia

defa-by-invoicemate.description: DeFa by InvoiceMate is a full-stack RWAFi protocol that transforms verified trade receivables into liquid, yield-bearing assets and connects liquidity providers with stable & secured yield backed by real-world economic activity.

huma.description: Permissionless DeFi yield, powered by real-world payment flows.

swissborg.description: Making crypto wealth management accessible to everyone.

soroswap-amm.description: Soroswap is an automated market maker comprising smart contracts that enable the creation of liquidity pools, provision of liquidity, and asset swaps

scopuly.description: Scopuly is the perfect way to buy, store, invest, trade, pay and transfer your crypto assets on Stellar. Only you control your funds.

spectra-v2.description: Secure your future yield at a fixed rate.

excellar.description: Excellar offers institutions and enterprises yield on stablecoins and major cryptocurrencies via delta-neutral strategies. It provides APIs to purchase, redeem, and manage USDXLR and other products. Using a segregated account structure, Excellar ensures transparent asset segregation and regulatory compliance. Its products are not available in the US and other restricted jurisdictions

blofin.description: Trade with Next-gen Experience, Profit from Functioning Strategies, and Keep Your Crypto Safe.

untangled-rwa.description: Untangled is an institutional-grade RWA credit protocol for fintechs around the world. The protocol has pioneered the first RWA credit oracle infrastructure, enabling dynamic pricing of RWAs with AI-driven risk models and zero-knowledge proof

xoxno-lending.description: XOXNO Stellar Lending is an overcollateralized lending protocol on Stellar

cex.io.description: CEX.IO, established in 2013 and registered in the UK, is a trusted global cryptocurrency exchange known for its regulatory compliance, deep liquidity, and security-first approach. The platform offers a comprehensive range of services, including spot and margin trading, instant purchases, staking, and crypto card payments

near-intents.description: NEAR Intents are a new type of transaction that allow information, requests, assets, and actions to be exchanged between AI agents, services, and end users

gate-us.description: Incorporated in the United States in 2020, Gate US leverages the proven expertise and global infrastructure of Gate to deliver a trusted and forward-looking digital asset platform. Built on a foundation of security, compliance, and innovation, Gate US provides access to a wide range of cryptocurrency trading opportunities while upholding the highest regulatory standards. By combining Gate's international leadership in blockchain technology with a localized U.S. approach, Gate US is committed to empowering individuals and institutions to participate confidently in the evolving digital economy.

phoenix-defi-hub.description: Empowered by Soroban's technology, Phoenix is pioneering the ultimate DeFi Hub within Stellar's vibrant ecosystem. We're forging synergistic protocols, starting with a cutting-edge DEX, to deliver the tastiest DeFi experience imaginable

vaquita-protocol.description: Vaquita is a platform that encourages long-term saving through dynamic rewards. We gamify saving by awarding additional interest to those who keep their commitment and penalizing early withdrawals, thereby ensuring higher returns.

peridot.description: Peridot Finance is a cross-chain lending protocol that utilizes a Hub & Spoke architecture to provide unified liquidity across BSC, Monad, Somnia, and several Ethereum L2s.

whalehub.description: Yield optimizer on Stellar blockchain built to maximize $AQUA protocol rewards with the help of whalehub native token BLUB.

sodex-bridge.description: SoDEX is a high-performance order book decentralized exchange (DEX) built on ValueChain.

balanced-exchange.description: Balanced includes a decentralised cross-chain exchange. Use it to swap assets, supply liquidity, and transfer crypto between supported blockchains. Its unified approach to cross-chain assets removes the need for wrapped tokens and fragmented liquidity, so you can enjoy a simpler trading experience.

osl-exchange.description: OSL Digital Securities is Hong Kong’s first and most established SFC-licensed and insured digital asset exchange. Operating since 2018, the platform provides institutional-grade digital asset services to corporations, financial institutions, professional and retail investors.

k2-lend.description: K2 Lend is a lending protocol on Stellar where users supply XLM, USDC, PYUSD, or SolvBTC to earn yield and borrow against collateral

slender.description: Slender is a noncustodial overcollateralized lending protocol on Soroban (Stellar).

alula.description: RWA-focused lending infrastructure with configurable, borrower-specific pools, curated vaults for LP yield optimization, and a native leverage module for yield-bearing RWA strategies.

blend-backstop.description: Insurance pool for lending markets created with Blend.

fxdao.description: FxDAO is the first protocol that allows the issuance of synthetic assets (stablecoins) backed by Stellar Lumens

blend-backstop-v2.description: Insurance pool for lending markets created with Blend.

normal.description: Normal is a synthetic asset and index fund protocol giving investors fast and reliable exposure to any crypto or RWA from a single chain, along with custom index funds to automate and diversify portfolio investing.

allbridge-core.description: Allbridge Core enables the transfer of value between blockchains by offering cross-chain swaps of native stablecoins. Being messaging protocol agnostic, Allbridge Core connects a variety of EVM and non-EVM networks.

project.name: Binance
project.shortDescription: Binance is a centralized exchange that lists XLM — 8 live XLM market(s) on CoinGecko as of 2026-08-21 (24h volume ≈ $47,848,168). Listed on the Stellar Playbook's centralized-exchanges directory.

project.name: Blend
project.shortDescription: Blend is a lending and borrowing protocol (money market) on Stellar Soroban. Anyone can deploy permissionless, isolated lending pools where suppliers earn yield (interest/APY) by depositing assets like USDC, XLM and EURC, and borrowers take over-collateralized loans. It is the base lending and yield primitive other Stellar DeFi apps build on.

project.name: Stellar DeFi Hub
project.shortDescription: Stellar DeFi Hub is a unified access point for DeFi activity on the Stellar network — operated by Ultrastellar (a Stellar ecosystem participant since 2014). Its launch surface is Sentora's curated non-custodial vaults on Stellar (also reachable via yield.xyz), with a roadmap spanning additional vault strategies across DeFi and real-world assets (RWAs).

project.name: Aquarius
project.shortDescription: Aquarius (AQUA) is a DeFi liquidity layer and AMM on Stellar/Soroban running stable and volatile AMM liquidity pools with multihop swaps where liquidity providers earn fees plus AQUA reward yield, and incentivizes market-making on the native Stellar DEX. Locking AQUA mints ICE; upvoteICE votes direct AQUA rewards to markets, and governICE votes on governance proposals without rewards.

audits.title: Aquarius AMM: Cantina (Cantina Aquarius Competition Security Report)
Aquarius AMM: Certora (Aquarius AMM Security Report by Certora)

project.name: Gami Labs
project.shortDescription: Gami Labs runs institutional-grade curated DeFi vaults with active on-chain curation and dynamic risk management (a professional 'risk curator'). Stellar is one of its largest deployments — roughly $19.7M of curated TVL on Stellar as of 2026-07-16 (DefiLlama) — alongside Ethereum, Base, Avalanche and Flare.

project.name: Upshift
project.shortDescription: Upshift is a multi-chain, institutional-grade vault infrastructure platform enabling wallets, exchanges, and neobanks to launch custom vaults spanning DeFi yield, RWAs, and PayFi. With TradFi-grade risk controls on 30+ chains, it reached $550M TVL at peak and is now expanding its vault standard to Stellar.

project.name: DeFindex
project.shortDescription: DeFindex (by PaltaLabs) is yield infrastructure on Stellar/Soroban. Non-custodial tokenized vaults let wallets, neobanks, and fintechs offer stablecoin savings: diversified yield strategies auto-rebalance USDC/EURC deposits across underlying protocols like Blend, abstracting lending and yield-vault primitives behind a single SDK and API.

project.name: Sushi
project.shortDescription: Sushi (formerly SushiSwap) is a multi-chain DeFi super app offering AMM-based token swaps, perpetuals trading, and liquidity provision. One of the most established DeFi protocols in the space, Sushi is now live on Stellar, bringing battle-tested decentralized exchange infrastructure with 5-second finality and sub-cent transaction fees.

project.name: Templar Protocol
project.shortDescription: Templar is a decentralized 'cypher lending' protocol that lets Stellar users borrow USDC against XLM collateral directly from their Stellar wallets, without bridges or wrapped tokens. It uses NEAR's multi-party-computation (MPC) network and Chain Signatures to custody deposits and settle cross-chain. On Stellar the collateral asset is XLM; Bitcoin-collateral and Ethereum/NEAR markets exist on its other deployments. The Stellar integration was announced November 2025.

project.name: Gate
project.shortDescription: Gate is a centralized exchange that lists XLM — 2 live XLM market(s) on CoinGecko as of 2026-08-21 (24h volume ≈ $4,900,173). Listed on the Stellar Playbook's centralized-exchanges directory.

project.name: DeFa by InvoiceMate
project.shortDescription: DeFa by InvoiceMate is on-chain Liquidity-as-a-Service infrastructure that tokenizes verified trade receivables and payment settlements, letting stablecoin liquidity finance real-world economic activity (invoice financing, PayFi settlement, growth capital). Private mainnet is live with gated early access; Stellar is its primary deployment (~$4M TVL on Stellar as of 2026-07-16 per DefiLlama).

project.name: Huma
project.shortDescription: Huma Finance is the first Payment Financing (PayFi) network, designed to provide instant liquidity solutions for global payments by leveraging blockchain technology.

contracts.label: Junior/Senior Tranche (docs list one address for both)

audits.title: Huma protocol: Certora (Security Assessment & Formal Verification Report | Huma protocol)

project.name: Soroswap
project.shortDescription: Soroswap is the first decentralized exchange (DEX) and DEX aggregator on Stellar Soroban, live on mainnet. It is an open-source AMM for swapping tokens and providing liquidity, with an aggregator that routes trades across Soroban AMMs (Soroswap, Phoenix, Aquarius) for best on-chain execution. Its swap Route API returns quotes and optimal routing across Stellar DEXs, including the Stellar classic DEX (SDEX).

project.name: Scopuly
project.shortDescription: Non-custodial Stellar wallet available across iOS, Android, macOS, Web, and Telegram. Supports asset management, payments, swaps, Stellar DEX trading, liquidity pools, multi-signature flows, and fiat on/off-ramps via MoneyGram and CCTP. Features over 19,800 wallets and 73,000+ tracked Stellar assets.

project.name: Spectra Finance
project.shortDescription: Spectra (by Perspective, spectra.finance) is a permissionless interest-rate derivatives protocol: a yield-bearing asset is split into a Principal Token (fixed rate) and a Yield Token (variable yield). Live on Stellar/Soroban since August 2026 with Principal Token markets on Blend-wrapped USDC and EURC, earnUSDC, earnXLM and the Centrifuge tokenized treasury fund deJTRSY, next to its EVM deployments, plus an EVM to Stellar bridge for Spectra PTs. The Soroban core, bridge and oracle contracts were audited by Certora in May 2026.

audits.title: Spectra Finance: Certora (Spectra Bridge - Certora Report)

project.name: Excellar
project.shortDescription: Excellar is bringing regulated yield-bearing crypto denominated liquid yield tokens to Stellar.

audits.title: Excellar: CoinFabrik (Excellar Audit)

project.name: Untangled
project.shortDescription: Untangled Vault is an automated, non-custodial, data-driven asset management protocol enabling anyone to set and execute strategies to fit investor risk/return appetite. Untangled Vault is powered by Untangled pool, an asset tokenization protocol focusing on RWA private credits and Credio, a risk oracle providing machine learning model inferences and onchain monitoring to RWA.

audits.title: OctoLend: Runtime Verification (OctoLend - Untangled - Security Audit Report)

project.name: XOXNO
project.shortDescription: XOXNO is an enterprise-grade decentralized lending protocol built on Stellar's Soroban smart contract platform. It opens up advanced on-chain capital strategies to more market participants through a clean and intuitive UI/UX, with plans to integrate RWA markets. Core features include eMode-style capital efficiency optimizations for correlated assets, looping strategies, leveraged long/short exposure via native aggregator integrations, flash loans, isolated liquidity pools with independent risk profiles, NFT-based position management, and multi-source oracle protection. The team previously built and scaled the XOXNO DeFi platform on MultiversX since 2021, serving 100,000+ users and processing $40M in on-chain marketplace volume.

project.name: Phoenix
project.shortDescription: Phoenix DeFi Hub is an SCF-funded AMM-based DEX on Stellar/Soroban (PHO token). It runs constant-product and stableswap liquidity pools where liquidity providers add liquidity to earn fees and staking rewards, with a Factory for creating pools and multi-hop routing for on-chain token swaps. One of the AMM liquidity sources aggregated by Soroswap.

project.name: Normal
project.shortDescription: A wrapped asset protocol helping institutions turn any token held in qualified custody into a yield-generating wrapped asset (“Normal Token”), which can be deployed as liquidity across DEXs. This makes it possible for investors to trade any crypto asset from a single interface and create on-chain crypto index fund tokens — each representing a diversified basket of assets, transparently rebalanced and fully tradable on-chain.

project.name: Allbridge
project.shortDescription: Allbridge enables users to access the Stellar ecosystem through cross-chain bridge swaps. Via Allbridge Core, Stellar joined as a supported chain (using Soroban) to offer native USDC and stablecoin cross-chain swaps without token wrapping, connecting Stellar to chains like Ethereum, Solana, Polygon, Base, Arbitrum and OP Mainnet — letting Stellar protocols tap cross-chain stablecoin liquidity.

venues.name: Soroswap
reads: Amount-specific route, fees and price impact
Minimum output, quote time and expiry
venues.exit: Swapped assets arrive in the wallet after confirmation.

venues.name: Blend
reads: Pool reserves, rates, liquidity and utilization
Account collateral, debt and native health
venues.exit: Withdrawal is limited by pool liquidity and collateral obligations.

venues.name: Templar
reads: Rates, native risk and available capacity
venues.source: Templar market API + verified settlement adapter
venues.exit: A withdrawal may enter a queue and require an external settlement step. Availability is variable.

venues.name: XOXNO
venues.exit: Market liquidity, account ownership and collateral safety constrain release.

venues.name: DeFindex
reads: Shares, underlying assets and product fees
venues.exit: Strategy liquidity, cooldowns and product rules must be verified before deposit.

venues.name: Upshift
reads: Receipt balance, share price and allocation
venues.exit: Request redemption and track settlement before a supported claim. Product-specific timing applies.

venues.name: Gami Labs
reads: Canonical Upshift vault and redemption model
venues.exit: Uses the underlying Upshift product’s redemption workflow. Curator is not a second position.

venues.name: Sentora
reads: Deposit lots, accrued and claimable rewards
venues.exit: Evergreen redemptions and campaign lot rules are separate. Verify release timing and forfeited rewards.
